- RAN3 to prioritize work on SON, including: PCI confusion handling Mobility Robustness Optimization RACH Optimization Load Balancing Capacity and Coverage Optimization Energy Efficiency - Other use cases will be discussed lower priority - RAN3 to work on RAN3 impacts related to the SA2 QoS monitoring solution in order to provide a reply to SA2 LS (R3-190030). RAN3 will take into consideration the related RAN2 work on L2 measurements of the RAN Centric DCU SI. Decision: The document was noted.
